dedupe_keys.name: germany solar panel satellite imagery object labels

description: The solar-panel satellite-imagery research team publishes object labels for image chips from three German satellite scenes. The Figshare documentation describes 2,542 label files, with normalised box coordinates and three categories for annotation confidence. Labels correspond to native-resolution and enhanced-resolution imagery, with chip dimensions and EPSG:32633 georeferencing instructions documented. Text annotations follow the YOLO format and are publicly available, free under CC BY 4.0. They can evaluate panel-detection models that prepare photovoltaic asset inventories for capacity-planning simulations such as model-system-advisor-model-sam. A caveat is that the companion images are supplied separately by Vantor, and their current access terms were not verified beyond a contact form. Labels alone do not supply panel capacity, ownership or generation. No label archive or image chips were downloaded.
